# Travellers of India

> > A comprehensive travel guide platform showcasing India's diverse destinations, adventure activities, cultural experiences, and practical travel advice for domestic and international explorers.

Travellers of India features destination guides across Indian states like Kerala, Himachal Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Uttarakhand, alongside travel stories from contributors, accommodation reviews, and practical checklists. The site covers mountain destinations, pilgrimage sites, adventure treks, culinary experiences, and romantic getaways, serving as a resource for both Indian and international travelers.

## Key Topics

- India Tourism
- Himachal Pradesh (Manali, Kasol)
- Kerala Travel
- Ladakh & Leh-Ladakh
- Mountain Destinations
- Adventure Travel & Trekking
- Travel Guides & Itineraries
- Romantic Destinations
- Pilgrimage Sites
- Travel Checklists
- Wildlife Parks
- Coorg
- Panchgani
- Road Trips
- Cultural Experiences

## Destination Guides

- [Top Ten Things to do in Trivandrum](https://www.travellersofindia.com/top-ten-things-trivandrum): Top 10 activities guide for Trivandrum, Kerala's capital city
- [5 Places to Visit Around Kasol](https://www.travellersofindia.com/5-places-visit-around-kasol): 5 must-visit destinations near Kasol in Himachal Pradesh's Parvati Valley
- [50 Best Places to Visit in December in the United States](https://www.travellersofindia.com/50-best-places-to-visit-in-december-united-states): Comprehensive guide to 50 top December winter destinations across the US
- [The 8 Sacred Sites in Gaya to Discover Self](https://www.travellersofindia.com/8-sacred-sites-gaya-discover-self): Guide to 8 sacred Buddhist, Hindu & Jain pilgrimage sites in Gaya, Bihar
- [Misal Pav of Nashik - Find the Best Spots](https://www.travellersofindia.com/misal-pav-of-nashik): Best restaurants & spots to try authentic Misal Pav in Nashik

- [Magical Music Treat in Ambukuthi Hills, Wayanad](https://www.travellersofindia.com/ambukuthi-mala-hills-wayanad): Trek experience to Ambukuthi Hills in Wayanad, Kerala with music treat
